boss:1.text: Flint was born in 1976. He had a poor background, growing up in poverty. At some point after Flint became the super criminal, Sandman, Peter Parker (going by the alias Spider-Man) kept a vial containing fragments of his memories. Flint also originally planned a robbery at F.E.A.S.T., until May Parker warded him off peacefully, making him realize the error of his ways when he saw poor people like himself.

boss:2.text: Afflicted with an inoperable cancer that sealed his fate, Kraven sought to perpetuate his ancestors' traditions by seeking a glorious death at the hands of a worthy predator, leading him to his last Great Hunt in New York City. He ruthlessly hunted down and killed many infamous supervillains, such as Scorpion, Vulture, Electro, and Shocker.

boss:3.text: He is first mentioned in Marvel's Spider-Man, when Spider-Man finds a backpack containing a vial of his blood, before making his on-screen debut in the mid-credits scene of Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales. He returns in Marvel's Spider-Man 2, not only as a prominent character, but as a major antagonist when Kraven the Hunter forcibly transforms him back into the Lizard before being cured by Spider-Man.
